selected.name: Yuna
selected.description: Malaysian singer-songwriter known for her soulful voice and blend of pop, R&B, and folk music.

properties.description: Established in 1949, this brand has evolved into a global leader in high-quality, functional everyday clothing. Operating under the philosophy of 'LifeWear', it focuses on technical innovation, clean design, and affordability to enhance the daily lives of a diverse consumer base. Its market position is defined by bridging the gap between mass-market retail and premium-quality basics. Through strategic global expansion and a commitment to sustainable production, the brand has become a staple for millions seeking simple, reliable, and intelligent apparel.
properties.short_description: Uniqlo is a Japanese casual wear designer and retailer offering high-quality, comfortable clothing and accessories for women, men, and children.

properties.description: A preeminent global fashion house founded in New York City in 1941, renowned for its enduring legacy in high-quality leatherware and lifestyle accessories. The brand balances its rich archival heritage with a modern design vision that prioritizes authentic self-expression and inclusive storytelling. Its extensive product range spans handbags, ready-to-wear clothing, footwear, and leather goods, appealing to a broad demographic of style-conscious individuals. By focusing on accessible luxury and craftsmanship, the entity maintains a significant presence in the global fashion market while continuously evolving its aesthetic to resonate with contemporary audiences.
properties.short_description: COACH is a luxury fashion brand known for handbags, wallets, clothing, menswear, shoes, and accessories.

properties.description: An iconic American lifestyle brand established in 1993, known for its focus on joy, color, and sophisticated design. Originally launched with a collection of six essential handbags, the brand has expanded into a global powerhouse offering apparel, jewelry, footwear, and home decor. It caters to individuals who appreciate a polished yet accessible aesthetic, balancing practical functionality with vibrant, playful elements. The brand occupies a premium market position, emphasizing thoughtful details and emotional connectivity in its product offerings.
properties.short_description: Kate Spade New York is a fashion brand known for designer handbags, clothing, jewelry, and accessories.

properties.description: Established in 1984, the brand is an American accessory manufacturer known for blending vintage design with modern functionality. It offers a broad collection of watches, leather goods, jewelry, and smartwatches aimed at a wide audience of professional and fashion-conscious consumers. The brand maintains a strong market presence through its focus on accessible luxury and timeless, classic aesthetics. By combining traditional leather craft with digital innovation, it caters to both heritage enthusiasts and modern tech users.
properties.short_description: Fossil is a global design and marketing company known for its distinctive watches, handbags, and jewelry.

properties.description: Established in 1916, the brand is widely recognized for creating the first rubber-soled canvas shoe, which helped pioneer the modern sneaker industry. It remains a staple of casual American footwear, celebrated for blending simple, clean aesthetics with lasting comfort. The brand offers a wide range of styles, from its signature lace-up originals to modern slip-ons and platforms, serving women and children. With a legacy centered on accessibility and practicality, it maintains a strong market position as an everyday shoe for diverse, active lifestyles.
properties.short_description: Keds is an American brand known for its canvas shoes with rubber soles, offering stylish and comfortable sneakers for women, men, and kids.
